## 入学条件 {#admissions}

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>A-level及GCSE要求：</strong>Excluded subjects General studies, critical thinking,及citizenship studies, global perspectives及research GCSEs GCSE maths grade 6 (B) 或 above, GCSE 英语 grade 5 (B) 或 above</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-cbb5dc3d88444d">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>IB要求：</strong>IB score 34 分 总分 或 666：3 HL certificates IB requirements GCSE maths 6 (B) 或 above OR 5：standard level 或 4：HL maths</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-cbb5dc3d88444d">官方依据</a></p>
